implementation.recognized_subroute: all nonzero local harmonic modulation polynomials have one exact nonconstant rational polynomial gcd and all exact quotients are constants
implementation.factor_authority: computed exact rational polynomial GCD plus exact zero-remainder division; no caller-supplied factor is authority
implementation.phase_partition: exact split at B-spline knot boundaries and every interior quarter-turn source point; each trigonometric chart is shifted by an exact cardinal quarter turn to avoid tangent-half poles
implementation.trigonometric_authority: PB-007-01 v6 exact rational-turn tangent-half/Sturm route
implementation.coincidence_authority: exact rational-root theorem enumeration plus exact rational-turn event checks; algebraic-irrational factor roots are disjoint from nonzero rational trigonometric factors under the recorded Gelfond-Schneider preconditions

theorem_boundary.recorded_application: if a factor root is algebraic irrational, rational-affine nonzero-rate phase keeps the turn algebraic irrational; a rational trigonometric-polynomial zero would make z=exp(2*pi*i*turn) algebraic, contradicting transcendence of the corresponding value of (-1)^(2*turn)
preconditions: source factor polynomial has rational coefficients
source/span affine maps have rational coefficients
phase offset and nonzero phase rate are rational
trigonometric factor is finite, nonzero and has rational harmonic coefficients
not_claimed: a general exact zero algorithm for arbitrary polynomial-modulated trigonometric sums
a general Pfaffian or continuous-Skolem decision procedure
an impossibility theorem for the remaining PB-007-01 grammar

boundary_controls: rational common-factor/trigonometric coincidence with additive multiplicity
algebraic-irrational common-factor root disjointness under explicit Gelfond-Schneider preconditions
exact quarter-turn partition and pole-safe chart shift
constant common factor does not masquerade as v8
zero phase rate is not promoted by v8
source-parameter mismatch remains rejected by v7 authority
binary-float and epsilon authority remain rejected
caller-supplied or forged common-factor authority is rejected as an unreviewed field
resource refusal is non-truth and cannot become success
MC-B cannot be promoted from this bounded subroute

full_blocker_review.reason: The common-factor product sublanguage is exactly decidable by existing rational-polynomial and rational-turn authorities, but the admitted v7 residual grammar still contains nonproportional nonconstant harmonic modulation polynomials for which no unconditional exact zero/multiplicity route is established.
full_blocker_review.residual_form: finite sums p_k(u) cos(2*pi*k*(a+b*u)) + q_k(u) sin(2*pi*k*(a+b*u)) where the nonzero rational polynomials do not all reduce to constants after division by one nonconstant common factor
